likely_causes.incomplete_answer_key: Physics key starts at 743 while normalized physics questions/solutions begin at 1, producing 732 missing_key conflicts before the keyed range. Math key ends at 2040, producing tail missing_key conflicts for statistics questions after 2040.
likely_causes.conflicting_extraction: Most math solution_key_mismatch rows in math-solutions-02/03 and some later files have very low question/solution text overlap, indicating solution snippets are attached to the wrong question number or OCR/extraction drifted.
likely_causes.stale_solution_stated_correct_option: Higher-overlap mismatch rows, especially physics rows and scattered math rows, are better candidates for stale stated_correct_option fields or true answer-key disagreement; these need source-page verification before changing keys.
